item.text: The active simulation path can take one more benefit from the new field API. I’m replacing the remaining `getObjectAt`/cast sequences inside `Consumer` with typed `getActorAt(...)` reads so the model layer is consistent end to end.
I tightened `Consumer` onto the typed field API as well. I’m rerunning the same compile check to make sure that last pass didn’t introduce any regressions.

Refactored the grid/statistics path to be type-safe and less globally coupled while keeping the legacy `Animal`/`Fox`/`Rabbit` files compatible. In [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Field.java:17) I added typed `Actor` accessors and placement overloads, and fixed the swapped dimensions bug in `createProducerField()` at [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Field.java:273). In [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/FieldStats.java:14) I removed the static mutable counters and made stats instance-based with typed maps, then wired that through [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Simulator.java:94), [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/SimulatorView.java:28), and [StatisticsView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/StatisticsView.java:40).

I also carried the typed API into the active model layer in [Consumer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Consumer.java:124), so mating, disease spread, and food lookup no longer bounce through raw `Object` values and casts. As small supporting cleanup, [Location.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Location.java:8) is now immutable with proper `@Override`s, and [Counter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Counter.java:12) now treats its name as immutable state.
